connector.name: Unsplash MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Unsplash API: search & fetch photos with attribution + download tracking.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package unsplash-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hanoak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
